subject: english
title: Unit 9 Grammar 2 App — Definitions with which
subtitle: Leo rebuilds the Lab Dictionary across the standard 12 grammar modules, finishing with the book's own Student Book p.155 Activity 1 definitions.

content: Write and say definitions of things independently using the frame noun + which + verb phrase.
Complete Student Book p.155 Activity 1 — write a definition with which for bicycle, skateboarding, friction, tetherball, and soccer.
Fuse two short sentences into one definition and delete the echoing pronoun the clause replaced.
language: Recycle the planner's warm-up words — connect, rub, skater, spin — by saying what each one means.
Choose between who and which by deciding whether the noun is a person or a thing, and use that as a substitute for which.
Meet the formative check: use which in definitions for skater and swing.
